verdict.rationale: The POS features page lists one event-triggered automation: low-stock notifications fired by sales-rate thresholds and powered by Shopify Flow. Nothing shows users defining their own general rules with arbitrary triggers and actions. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined rule authoring (custom triggers, conditions, actions) within POS, a range of event types beyond low-stock alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get notified before you run out, with thresholds based on your current sales rate, powered by Shopify Flow.
